summary.zh-CN: 用 gh CLI 管理 Issues、PR、CI 检查、代码审查、发布与 API 查询；需要用户已安装并登录 gh，写操作须逐项经本人确认。
summary.en: Manage issues, PRs, CI runs, code reviews, releases, and API queries with the gh CLI; requires the user to have gh installed and authenticated; every write operation needs the owner's explicit approval.

modifications.zh-CN: frontmatter 只保留 name 与 description，去掉 metadata.openclaw（含 emoji、requires.bins 与 install brew 指令）等 OpenClaw 专属字段。
modifications.en: Frontmatter keeps only name and description; OpenClaw-specific metadata.openclaw (including emoji, requires.bins, and install brew directive) removed.

modifications.zh-CN: 移除正文中 OpenClaw 会话 footer 模板（"View the OpenClaw team session" 段落），该部分依赖 OpenClaw Runtime 注入的 sessionUrl，在 Teloa 中不适用。
modifications.en: Removed the OpenClaw session footer template from the body (the 'View the OpenClaw team session' paragraph); it depends on OpenClaw Runtime's sessionUrl injection, which is not applicable in Teloa.

modifications.zh-CN: 仓库根 LICENSE（MIT）与 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 随资源文件收录。
modifications.en: The repository root LICENSE (MIT) and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md are included with the resource files.

conditions.zh-CN: 需要用户自行安装 gh CLI 并完成 gh auth login；Teloa 不负责安装 gh 或代为登录。
conditions.en: Requires the user to install gh CLI and run gh auth login; Teloa does not install gh or log in on the user's behalf.

conditions.zh-CN: 任何写操作（创建 Issue/PR、推送代码、合并、评论等）必须经仓库所有人逐项明确确认后方可执行。
conditions.en: Any write operation (creating issues/PRs, pushing code, merging, commenting, etc.) must be explicitly approved by the repository owner before execution.
